zh-Hant.title: 第一次讓 AI 完成一件事
zh-Hant.goal: 在電腦送出一個問題，核對期限與未知，保存能重開的結果。
zh-Hant.quick: 先不看步驟：開新對話，把下方通知整理成一項待辦，指出來源與未知，保存結果。
zh-Hant.skip: 能展示已送出的問題、正確期限、未知及重新開啟的紀錄，就可跳到獨立練習。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構教學通知 A1
活動日期：2026/11/21。
請於2026/11/18 18:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆是否參加。
集合地點尚未公布。
zh-Hant.prompt: 只根據通知 A1，寫一項待辦，包含動作、期限、來源；再列一項待確認資訊。不要補猜。
steps: 保留本教材分頁；另開瀏覽器分頁，進入你可使用的 AI 工具。依畫面完成登入；無法使用者先觀察示範，實作記為待補。
在 AI 工具開啟新對話，找到訊息輸入區。回教材複製來源文字，切回 AI 貼入，再貼入問題。
檢查輸入文字完整後，按工具畫面的送出控制；等回答出現。這一步是在 AI 工具完成，不是按教材的複製按鈕。
切回教材，比對回答：回覆期限是11/18 18:00，不是活動日11/21；集合地點仍未知。若不符，追問『請依A1修正，不要猜地點』。
回到本頁，把實際送出的問題貼到「我實際送出的要求」，把回答、來源A1與核對結果貼到「我的結果與核對方式」。按「下載這課操作紀錄」，從瀏覽器下載清單開啟剛下載的文字檔，確認內容都在；可另存到自己的練習資料夾。
zh-Hant.expected: 待辦：於2026/11/18 18:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆是否參加；來源A1。待確認：集合地點。活動日2026/11/21不是回覆期限。文字表達可不同，事實必須一致。

independent.task: 新資料（虛構）A2：2026/12/03讀書活動；12/01 12:00（Asia/Taipei）前選一個主題；教室未定。另開新對話，寫待辦及未知，保存為第二份紀錄。
independent.expected: 12/01 12:00前選一個主題；來源A2；教室待確認；活動日12/03。需實際保存並重開，只有看答案不算操作完成。

challenge.task: 把資料改成給同伴看的兩句話，保留期限與未知。
challenge.source: 虛構A3：2026/12/05分享會；12/02 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前繳交題目；每人分享5分鐘；場地未定。
challenge.prompt: 將A3改成兩句話：第一句寫需完成的事與期限，第二句寫活動日、分享時間及未知。
challenge.expected: 請於2026/12/02 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前繳交題目。分享會在12/05，每人5分鐘，場地待確認。

checks: 已在AI工具送出問題，能辨認教材與AI兩個位置。
期限、來源及未知均與A1一致。
紀錄已保存且能重新開啟；未操作的部分標為待補。

quiz.question: A1的回覆期限是哪個？

en.title: Complete your first AI task
en.goal: Send a request on a computer, verify the deadline and unknowns, and save a result you can reopen.
en.quick: Before reading the steps, open a new chat, turn the notice below into one action, identify its source and an unknown, and save it.
en.skip: Skip to independent practice if you can show the submitted request, correct deadline, unknown, and reopened record.
en.source:
Fictional teaching notice A1
Activity date: 2026/11/21.
Reply whether you will attend by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei).
The meeting location has not been announced.
en.prompt: Using only notice A1, write one action with its deadline and source. List one item that needs confirmation. Do not guess.
steps: Keep this lesson tab open. Open another browser tab and visit an AI tool you can use. Sign in using its interface. If access is unavailable, observe a demonstration and record hands-on work as pending.
Start a new chat in the AI tool and find its message input. Return to this lesson, copy the source, switch back to the AI tool, paste it, then paste the prompt.
Check that the text is complete, then use the tool's send control. Wait for its answer. This happens in the AI tool; copying text in this lesson does not submit it.
Return to the lesson and compare: the reply deadline is 11/18 18:00, not the activity date 11/21. The location remains unknown. If needed, ask: 'Correct this using A1; do not guess the location.'

Return to this lesson. Paste your submitted request into the request field and the answer, source A1, and verification into the result and verification field. Select Download this lesson record, then open the downloaded text file from the browser download list and check its contents. You may also save a copy in your practice folder.
en.expected: Action: reply whether you will attend by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei); source A1. To confirm: meeting location. The activity date, 2026/11/21, is not the reply deadline. Wording may differ; facts must match.

independent.task: New fictional source A2: reading activity on 2026/12/03; choose a topic by 12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei); classroom undecided. In a new chat, write the action and unknown, and save a second record.
independent.expected: Choose a topic by 12/01 12:00; source A2; classroom to confirm; activity on 12/03. Actually save and reopen it; reading this answer alone is not hands-on completion.

challenge.task: Make a two-sentence note for a partner, preserving the deadline and unknown.
challenge.source: Fictional A3: sharing session on 2026/12/05; submit a topic by 12/02 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); 5 minutes per speaker; venue undecided.
challenge.prompt: Rewrite A3 in two sentences. Put the action and deadline in the first; put the activity date, speaking time, and unknown in the second.
challenge.expected: Submit your topic by 2026/12/02 17:00 (Asia/Taipei). The session is on 12/05, with 5 minutes per speaker; the venue is to be confirmed.

checks: Submitted a request in an AI tool and can distinguish it from the lesson tab.
Deadline, source, and unknown match A1.
Saved and reopened the record; unperformed operations are marked pending.

quiz.question: What is A1's reply deadline?
quiz.explanation: A1 explicitly says 11/18 18:00. The activity date, 11/21, is a different field.

zh-Hant.title: 改一處，確認結果跟著變
zh-Hant.goal: 只更新受影響欄位，保留不變資訊與未知。
zh-Hant.quick: 先預測：車票期限20:00改19:00後，哪一項改變？哪兩項不應跟著改？
zh-Hant.skip: 能交出更新前、更新內容與更新後，正確指出一改兩不改，可直接挑戰。
zh-Hant.source: 虛構B0，時間Asia/Taipei：2026/11/19 20:00前下載車票；2026/11/21 09:00在雲岸車站集合；入住時間未提供。
zh-Hant.prompt: 只依B0列出下載期限、集合、入住三欄，每欄附來源；缺值標待確認，不補猜。這是更新前的第一版。
steps: 先把預測寫下：下載期限提早1小時；集合與入住不變。
先複製B0與第一輪問題送給AI，保存初版。接著複製本課「第二輪追問」的B1與要求，貼到同一個AI對話送出，才比對更新結果。
比對兩版的日期與時間。若集合也改了，追問『B1只改下載期限；請還原沒有依據的修改』。
把三份文字保存：B0初版、B1更新、核對後結果；標示變動欄位。
zh-Hant.expected: 第一輪B0：下載期限2026/11/19 20:00；集合2026/11/21 09:00、雲岸車站；入住時間未提供，待確認。來源皆B0，時間Asia/Taipei。此刻尚未套用B1，19:00不是這一輪的答案。

independent.task: 新資料（虛構）R0：2026/12/04 16:00前交報告；12/06 10:00討論；會議室未定。R1：負責人確認交報告改15:00，其餘不變。時間Asia/Taipei。請自行製作三欄前後對照。

challenge.task: 整理衝突，不自行選一個期限。
challenge.source: 虛構C1：窗口甲說2026/11/19 19:00前下載。C2：窗口乙說同日18:30前下載。兩者都未說取代哪份通知，也未指定誰有決定權。時間Asia/Taipei。
challenge.prompt: 列出C1、C2的衝突、共同資訊及需要向誰確認；不要以較早或較新當作已確認答案。
challenge.expected: 共同：兩份下載期限都在2026/11/19；確切時間待確認。衝突：19:00與18:30相差30分鐘；有效截止時間待確認。向主辦決策窗口確認哪份有效及是否取代另一份；不能聲稱18:30已被正式採用。

checks: 只有下載期限改變。
集合09:00與入住待確認均保留。
保存前後版本與自己的核對註記。

quiz.question: B1套用後，入住時間應寫什麼？
quiz.explanation: 兩個時間各有用途，不能用來補猜入住時間。

followup.source: 虛構B1：主辦者確認只把下載車票期限改為2026/11/19 19:00（Asia/Taipei），其餘依B0。
followup.prompt: 請在剛才B0結果套用B1，列更新前／更新後／改變原因，只改有來源支持的欄位，保留不變資訊與未知。
followup.expected: 下載期限：11/19 20:00→19:00，提早1小時，依B1。集合：11/21 09:00雲岸車站→相同，依B0。入住：未提供→待確認，沒有新資料。全部為2026年、Asia/Taipei。

en.title: Change one thing and verify the result
en.goal: Update only the affected field, preserving unchanged facts and unknowns.
en.quick: Predict first: if the ticket deadline changes from 20:00 to 19:00, what changes and which two fields must stay the same?
en.skip: Go to the challenge if your before, update, and after records show one correct change and two unchanged fields.
en.source: Fictional B0; time zone Asia/Taipei: download tickets by 2026/11/19 20:00; meet at Cloudbank Station on 2026/11/21 at 09:00; check-in time not provided.
en.prompt: Using B0 only, list ticket deadline, meeting, and check-in with a source for each. Mark missing values to confirm; do not guess. This is the first version before any update.
steps: Write your prediction: ticket deadline moves 1 hour earlier; meeting and check-in information stay unchanged.
Submit B0 and the first prompt, then save the initial answer. Next copy B1 and the request from the second-turn follow-up into the same AI chat and send them before comparing the updated result.
Compare dates and times. If the meeting changed too, ask: 'B1 only changes the download deadline. Restore unsupported changes.'
Save three records: the B0 result, B1 update, and verified final result. Mark the changed field.
en.expected: First turn, B0: ticket download deadline 2026/11/19 20:00; meeting 2026/11/21 09:00 at Cloudbank Station; check-in not provided, to confirm. All sourced to B0, time zone Asia/Taipei. B1 has not been applied yet; 19:00 is not the answer for this turn.

independent.task: New fictional R0: report due 2026/12/04 16:00; discussion 12/06 10:00; room undecided. R1: the owner confirms the report deadline changes to 15:00; everything else stays the same. Time zone Asia/Taipei. Make a before/after comparison yourself.
independent.expected: Report deadline 12/04 16:00 → 15:00, 1 hour earlier; discussion remains 12/06 10:00; room remains to confirm.

challenge.task: Identify the conflict without choosing an unsupported deadline.
challenge.source: Fictional C1: contact A says download by 2026/11/19 19:00. C2: contact B says 18:30 the same day. Neither states which notice is replaced or who has authority. Time zone Asia/Taipei.
challenge.prompt: List the conflict, common facts, and who should confirm the answer. Do not treat earlier or newer as a confirmed answer.
challenge.expected: Shared fact: download is due on 2026/11/19. Conflict: 19:00 versus 18:30, a 30-minute difference; the valid deadline is unconfirmed. Ask the organizer's decision owner which notice is valid and whether it replaces the other. Do not claim 18:30 is officially adopted.

checks: Only the download deadline changed.
The 09:00 meeting and unconfirmed check-in remain.
Saved both versions and personal verification notes.

quiz.question: After applying B1, what is the check-in time?
choices: To confirm; the source does not provide it
quiz.explanation: Those times refer to different actions and cannot fill the missing check-in time.

followup.source: Fictional B1: the organizer confirms that only the ticket download deadline changes to 2026/11/19 19:00 (Asia/Taipei). Everything else follows B0.
followup.prompt: Apply B1 to your previous B0 result. Show before / after / reason, changing only source-supported fields and preserving unchanged facts and unknowns.
followup.expected: Ticket deadline: 11/19 20:00 → 19:00, 1 hour earlier, supported by B1. Meeting: 11/21 09:00 at Cloudbank Station → unchanged, supported by B0. Check-in: not provided → to confirm; no new data. All dates are in 2026, Asia/Taipei.

zh-Hant.title: 讀資料、比較版本、回來源核對
zh-Hant.goal: 為每個結論找到依據，分開確定、缺漏與衝突。
zh-Hant.quick: 下方B與D何者是有效集合時間？較新的E可以直接取代B嗎？用原文理由回答。
zh-Hant.skip: 能指出採用依據、未解衝突與需要確認的發布者，可直接做獨立題。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構資料，時間Asia/Taipei。
D｜10/20發布：2026/11/21 10:00雲岸車站集合。
B｜10/25主辦核准：取代D；2026/11/21 09:00雲岸車站集合；11/19 19:00前下載車票；入住未定。
E｜10/28討論草稿：建議11/21 08:30集合，尚未核准。
F｜接駁筆記：11/21 09:30發車；未註明核准狀態。
zh-Hant.prompt: 逐項列結論、來源原句、確定／缺漏／衝突、採用理由。區分集合、下載期限與發車。不要只靠日期或檔名判斷可信度。
steps: 先標出每份資料的發布日、核准狀態與取代關係。
將來源與問題一起交給AI，要求每項結論附來源代號。
回原文核對：B明確取代D；E雖新但未核准；F是發車而非集合時間。
追問『哪些仍須向主辦確認？』，保存來源對照與待確認清單。
zh-Hant.expected: 目前核准集合：2026/11/21 09:00雲岸車站（B明確取代D）；目前09:00比舊版10:00提早1小時。下載：11/19 19:00（B），不是集合時間。E的08:30仍是未核准建議，不能取代B。F的09:30是發車筆記，須向主辦確認有效性；不能直接當成與09:00集合衝突。入住缺漏。

independent.task: 虛構P：10/26核准，報名上限20人。Q：10/29草稿，建議30人，未核准。R：10/28窗口留言『上限25人』，未說是否取代P。請列目前核准值與未解事項。
independent.expected: 已知核准值20人（P）；30人是草稿；25人留言與P不同但權限／取代關係不明，需向決策者確認，不能宣稱最後有效上限必為25或30。

challenge.task: 在沒有目前核准版的情況下，保留不確定。
challenge.prompt: 今天可以確認費用是多少嗎？列出兩份資料的限制與需要的證據。
challenge.expected: 無法確認當前費用。V1已過期；V2較新但未核准。需取得當前核准的費用通知、適用日期及發布者確認；不能選300或350作為已確認值。

checks: 每個結論有來源代號與核對理由。
沒有把較新等同可信，也沒有混合不同時間用途。
保留缺漏及需向主辦確認的事項。

quiz.question: 為什麼本題採用B的09:00？
choices: 任何較新的文件都有效
quiz.explanation: 採用理由是核准與取代關係；更新日期本身不充分。

en.title: Read, compare, and verify sources
en.goal: Find evidence for each conclusion and separate confirmed facts, missing data, and conflicts.
en.quick: Which meeting time in B and D is valid? Can the newer E replace B? Answer using source wording.
en.skip: Go to independent practice if you can explain the selection, unresolved issues, and who needs to confirm them.
en.source:
Fictional data; time zone Asia/Taipei.
D | issued 10/20: meet at Cloudbank Station on 2026/11/21 at 10:00.
B | organizer approved 10/25: replaces D; meet at Cloudbank Station on 2026/11/21 at 09:00; download tickets by 11/19 19:00; check-in undecided.
E | discussion draft 10/28: suggests meeting on 11/21 at 08:30; not approved.
F | shuttle note: departs 11/21 at 09:30; approval status not stated.
en.prompt: For each item, list conclusion, supporting source wording, confirmed / missing / conflict, and selection reason. Distinguish meeting, download deadline, and departure. Do not judge credibility only by date or filename.
steps: Mark the issue date, approval status, and replacement relationship for each source.
Submit the sources and prompt to AI; request a source ID for every conclusion.
Check the original text: B explicitly replaces D; E is newer but unapproved; F is a departure time, not a meeting time.
Ask which items still need organizer confirmation. Save the source comparison and questions.
en.expected: Currently approved meeting: 2026/11/21 09:00 at Cloudbank Station (B explicitly replaces D), 1 hour earlier than D's 10:00. Download deadline: 11/19 19:00 (B), not the meeting. E's 08:30 is unapproved and cannot replace B. F's 09:30 is a departure note whose validity needs organizer confirmation; it is not automatically a conflict with the 09:00 meeting. Check-in is missing.

independent.task: Fictional P: approved 10/26, registration limit 20 people. Q: draft 10/29 suggests 30, unapproved. R: contact message 10/28 says 'limit 25' without stating whether it replaces P. List the approved value and unresolved issues.
independent.expected: Known approved value: 20 (P). The 30-person value is a draft. The 25-person message differs from P, but authority and replacement are unclear. Ask the decision owner; do not assert that 25 or 30 is the final valid limit.

challenge.task: Preserve uncertainty when no current approved version is available.
challenge.source: Fictional V1: valid through 2026/10/20; fee 300 TWD. V2: draft dated 2026/10/28; proposed fee 350 TWD, unapproved. Inquiry date: 2026/10/29.
challenge.prompt: Can today's fee be confirmed? State the limitations of both documents and the evidence needed.
challenge.expected: The current fee cannot be confirmed. V1 expired; V2 is newer but unapproved. Obtain the current approved fee notice, effective dates, and publisher confirmation. Neither 300 nor 350 can be presented as confirmed.

checks: Every conclusion has a source ID and verification reason.
Newer was not equated with credible; times with different purposes were not mixed.
Missing information and organizer questions remain visible.

quiz.question: Why use B's 09:00 in this exercise?
choices: B is approved and explicitly replaces D
quiz.explanation: Approval and replacement support the choice. A newer date alone is insufficient.

zh-Hant.title: Gmail：找該處理的信，寫回覆草稿
zh-Hant.goal: 讀取指定教學郵件，整理待辦與尚未寄出的回覆。
zh-Hant.quick: 找出指定信串的最新有效期限，指出原信依據；說明你是實際讀信或貼文字練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 能透過可用外掛讀取指定信串並回原信核對，分清草稿與寄出，可跳基礎步驟；貼文字只完成整理部分。
zh-Hant.source:
以下全為虛構教學郵件，不是你的實際收件匣。
信串主旨：[AI Lab] 雲岸活動確認
G1｜內文標示2026/10/27｜主辦：請於11/18 18:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆是否參加；集合地點待定。
G2｜內文標示2026/10/28｜同一主辦回覆：回覆期限改11/18 17:00，其餘不變。
學員本次決定：會參加；希望詢問集合地點。 以上日期是虛構內文版本日期，並非實際收件日期；實際寄送／收到時間依課前準備當天。
zh-Hant.prompt: 只讀取主旨為[AI Lab] 雲岸活動確認、實際收件日期為【填入課前準備當天日期】的指定教學信串，包含更新回覆。列出有效期限、待辦、來源及未知，草擬我會參加且詢問集合地點的回覆。只在對話輸出草稿，不建立Gmail草稿、不寄出。若無法讀信，明確說明；不要聲稱已搜尋。
steps: 連線路線：先由講師在專用教學帳號準備G1、G2為同一信串，核對主旨與實際收件日期，再把問題中的日期佔位文字替換成該日期；內文虛構日期不作收件搜尋條件，再依共用連線指引確認Gmail外掛可用及允許的帳號。帳號／方案不支援時改貼文字，紀錄『連線待補』。
連線路線送出問題並限定信串；貼文字路線把來源與問題一起送出，將問題的讀信指令改成『只整理下方貼上的文字』。
打開工具回傳的來源信串，核對G1與G2原文。若只有搜尋摘要或無法開來源，不能算讀信核對完成。
檢查草稿是11/18 17:00、會參加、詢問地點；沒有捏造地點，也沒有把已讀當成已回覆。
保存草稿與來源紀錄，狀態寫『對話草稿，未寄出』。寄出是另一次明確決定，本課停在草稿。
zh-Hant.expected: 待辦：11/18 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆參加，依G2取代G1的18:00。未知：集合地點。草稿：『您好，我會參加雲岸活動。請問集合地點何時公布？謝謝。』狀態：僅對話草稿，未建立Gmail草稿、未寄出。

en.title: Gmail: find actions and draft replies

en.source:
All emails below are fictional teaching material, not your actual inbox.
Subject: [AI Lab] Cloudbank activity confirmation
G1 | body version date 2026/10/27 | Organizer: reply whether attending by 11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei); meeting location undecided.
G2 | body version date 2026/10/28 | Same organizer replies: reply deadline changes to 11/18 17:00; all else unchanged.
Learner decision for this exercise: will attend; wants to ask about the meeting location. These are fictional version dates inside the email body, not actual receipt dates; sending/receipt occurs when the lesson is prepared.
en.prompt: Read only the teaching thread with subject [AI Lab] Cloudbank activity confirmation, received on [enter the actual preparation date], including updates. List the valid deadline, action, sources, and unknowns. Draft a reply saying I will attend and asking about the meeting location. Output text in this chat only; do not create a Gmail draft or send. If mail cannot be read, say so; do not claim you searched.
steps: Connected route: the instructor first prepares G1 and G2 as one thread in a dedicated teaching account and verifies the subject and actual receipt date, then replaces the date placeholder with that date; fictional body dates are not receipt-date filters. Follow the shared connection guide to check Gmail plugin availability and the permitted account. If unsupported by the account or plan, paste the text and record connection as pending.
For the connected route, submit the scoped request. For pasted-text practice, submit the source too and replace the mail-reading instruction with 'Organize only the text pasted below.'
Open the source thread returned by the tool and verify G1 and G2. A search snippet or an inaccessible source does not complete original-email verification.
Check the deadline is 11/18 17:00, the reply says you will attend, and it asks about the location. Do not invent a location or treat read mail as answered mail.
Save the draft and source record, labeled 'chat draft, not sent.' Sending requires a separate explicit decision; this lesson ends at the draft.
en.expected: Action: reply that you will attend by 11/18 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); G2 replaces G1's 18:00. Unknown: meeting location. Draft: 'Hello, I will attend the Cloudbank activity. When will the meeting location be announced? Thank you.' Status: chat text only; no Gmail draft created and nothing sent.

independent.task: New fictional H1: subject [AI Lab] Book pickup confirmation; fictional body version date 2026/11/02; confirm pickup by 11/05 12:00 (Asia/Taipei); location undecided. Your decision: you can pick it up. Independently write an action and reply using pasted text. To practice a connection, ask the instructor to prepare this email in the teaching account first, then scope reading by subject and actual preparation/receipt date, not the fictional body date.
independent.expected: Confirm by 11/05 12:00; source H1; location unknown. Draft: 'I can pick it up. Please let me know the pickup location. Thank you.' Unsent. Without evidence of connected reading, label this pasted-text practice.

challenge.task: Separate a partial reply from a schedule update.
challenge.source: Fictional thread: J1 organizer says meet 2026/11/07 09:00 and asks for attendance and meal choice. J2 organizer changes meeting to 10:00; all else unchanged. J3 learner replies only 'I will attend.' Meal choice remains unanswered. Time zone Asia/Taipei.

challenge.expected: Meet 11/07 10:00 (J2); attendance answered (J3); meal unanswered. Attendance alone does not complete everything. Ask the learner 'Which meal would you like?' Do not fill in or send a choice before receiving it.

checks: The search scope and source thread are explicit, including the update.
Connected reading and pasted text are recorded separately.
Deadline and draft are verified and the unsent status is clear.

quiz.question: After pasting G1 and G2 into AI, what can you claim?
choices: Pasted-text organization is complete; Gmail connection is unverified
quiz.explanation: Organizing text, reading an account, and sending mail are different operations.

zh-Hant.title: Google Drive：找文件、比較方案

zh-Hant.skip: 能讀取指定文件、對齊口徑、附來源與未知，可直接做不同幣別挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構教學文件，皆適用2026/11/21、4人、TWD。
[AI Lab] 方案A核准版：交通每人600；四人住宿共2400；含早餐。
[AI Lab] 方案B核准版：交通四人共2200；四人住宿共2600；早餐另計，價格未提供。
zh-Hant.prompt: 只讀取指定的[AI Lab] 方案A核准版與方案B核准版內文。以2026/11/21、4人、TWD比較交通、住宿、早餐、已知小計、未知費用，列算式與來源。不能把未知當零；讀不到內文就說明。
steps: 講師先在專用教學Drive建立兩份文件，標題及內文使用來源文字；學員取得兩份文件的實際連結並確認可開啟。依共用指引確認可用外掛與帳號。
把實際教學文件連結加入問題以精確指定；若無連線，改貼來源並要求『只比較貼上的文字』，註記連線待補。
確認AI讀到交通與早餐欄位；只找到檔名或摘要不算完成。回兩份文件逐欄核對。
先把A交通換算為600×4，再加住宿；B使用整組交通價。追問『哪些費用還未知，所以不能斷言較便宜？』。
保存比較表、算式、文件版本及讀取方式。
zh-Hant.expected: A交通600×4=2400、住宿2400、早餐已含，依已提供項目合計4800 TWD。B交通2200、住宿2600，已知小計4800 TWD，另有未知早餐費。兩者已知小計相同，不能把B早餐當0或宣稱B完整費用較低。

independent.task: 新虛構文件C：2人，TWD，每人票價350，雙人房1800，含早餐。D：2人票共600，雙人房1900，含早餐。同為2026/12/01且本題比較範圍僅票、房、早餐。請自行比較並標示來源。
independent.expected: C：350×2+1800=2500；D：600+1900=2500 TWD；同口徑合計相同。不能從此推論服務品質相同。

challenge.task: 處理不同人數與幣別，不假造換算。
challenge.source: 虛構方案E：2026/11/21，3人，總價150 USD，含交通與住宿，早餐未說明。方案F：同日4人，總價4800 TWD，含交通、住宿、早餐。沒有匯率。
challenge.prompt: 列能算的數字、不能比較的原因與需補資訊；不要查外部匯率或推薦方案。
challenge.expected: E每人50 USD；F每人1200 TWD。人數、幣別與早餐包含範圍不同，無法直接判斷高低；需同人數報價、約定匯率及日期、早餐費與包含條件。

checks: 確實核對內文，沒有把檔名當讀取證據。
每人／整組、人數、日期、幣別一致。
未知早餐費未補成零；保留算式及來源。

quiz.question: B的4800 TWD代表什麼？
choices: 已知小計，早餐費仍未知
含所有項目的完整總額
quiz.explanation: 4800只包含來源已提供的交通與住宿。

en.title: Google Drive: find files and compare options
en.goal: Read specified file contents, compare the same group size and currency, and preserve unknown costs.
en.quick: Compare 600 per person with 2200 for 4 people. Which known transport subtotal is lower, and is the complete cost known?

Fictional teaching files; both for 2026/11/21, 4 people, TWD.
[AI Lab] Approved option A: transport 600 per person; lodging 2400 for four; breakfast included.
[AI Lab] Approved option B: transport 2200 for four; lodging 2600 for four; breakfast extra, price not provided.

Add the actual teaching-file links to scope the request precisely. Without a connection, paste the source and request comparison of pasted text only; record connection as pending.
Confirm AI read the transport and breakfast fields. A filename or search snippet alone is insufficient. Check each field in both original files.

Aligned per-person/group pricing, group size, date, and currency.
Did not replace unknown breakfast cost with zero; retained formulas and sources.

zh-Hant.source:
虛構教學頁：[AI Lab] 讀書會起步 N1
活動：2026/11/21 14:00（Asia/Taipei），6人。
T01：小禾於11/18前選三篇文章，未完成。
T02：11/19前確認場地，負責人未定，未完成。

缺負責人／預算沒有猜測。

zh-Hant.title: 表格：看懂每月差異

independent.task: 新虛構資料（TWD）：9月書籍300、交通200；10月書籍360、交通240。算兩月總額與增幅，再比較分類增加>40及>=40。

challenge.task: 同時處理缺值、零基期與不同幣別。
challenge.source: 虛構，逐分類比較：9月課程0 TWD、餐食100 TWD；10月課程200 TWD、餐食金額缺漏、書籍10 USD。沒有匯率；不能補猜金額。
challenge.prompt: 按幣別列已知小計、未知及能算的差額。課程百分比可算嗎？能宣稱10月完整總額或整體增幅嗎？
challenge.expected: 9月已知TWD合計100；10月已知TWD小計200，餐食未知，另有10 USD不能直接相加。課程差額+200，但基期0，百分比不適用。10月完整總額與整體增幅無法確認，不能用已知小計當完整總額。

checks: >50一類、>=50三類，沒有改動原資料。
退款後2250、+150、7.1%；缺值與零保持不同。

quiz.question: 原六列改用『至少50』後，符合幾類？
quiz.explanation: 至少包含等於；150、50、50都符合。篩選門檻不改變原總額。

en.title: Tables: understand monthly changes
en.goal: Recalculate totals and changes, distinguishing greater than, at least, refunds, and unknowns.
en.quick: Calculate both monthly totals from six rows. Predict the category count when 'increase greater than 50' becomes 'increase at least 50.'
en.skip: Go to the challenge if you can recalculate differences, percentage denominator, and boundaries, and explain why missing is not zero.
en.source:
Fictional spending; purchase-month basis; all TWD. Positive values are spending; negatives are refunds.
ID,Month,Category,Amount
S01,2026-09,Meals,1200
S02,2026-09,Transport,400
S03,2026-09,Services,500
O01,2026-10,Meals,1350
O02,2026-10,Transport,450
O03,2026-10,Services,550
en.prompt: Using only these six rows, calculate September and October totals, October minus September, and difference divided by September total as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal. Show category differences and source IDs. First select increases >50, then >=50; explain whether totals change. Do not guess causes.
steps: Manually calculate September 1200+400+500 and October 1350+450+550 and record your prediction.
Submit the six rows and prompt. Use a calculator to check both totals and 250÷2100×100.
Check category increases: meals 150, transport 50, services 50. Apply >50, then change only the condition to >=50; observe 1 category becoming 3.
Follow up: 'Add an October meals refund of -100, assigned to October purchase month; recalculate.' Keep the original six rows and add a refund row instead of overwriting 1350.
Save the data scope, formulas, threshold results, and refund results. Describe numeric changes without claiming price rises or behavior changes.
en.expected: Original six rows: September 2100; October 2350; increase 250; 250÷2100×100≈11.9%. Categories: meals +150, transport +50, services +50. >50 selects meals only, 1 category; >=50 selects 3. Monthly totals do not change. After an October meals refund of -100: October 2250, increase 150, 150÷2100×100≈7.1%; net meals 1250, with all three categories +50.

independent.task: New fictional TWD data: September books 300, transport 200; October books 360, transport 240. Calculate monthly totals and percentage change, then compare category increases >40 and >=40.
independent.expected: September 500; October 600; increase 100, 20.0%. Books +60, transport +40. >40 selects 1 category; >=40 selects 2. Thresholds do not change totals.

challenge.task: Handle missing amounts, a zero baseline, and different currencies together.
challenge.source: Fictional category data: September courses 0 TWD, meals 100 TWD; October courses 200 TWD, meals amount missing, books 10 USD. No exchange rate; do not guess amounts.
challenge.prompt: List known subtotals by currency, unknowns, and valid differences. Can the courses percentage be calculated? Can a complete October total or overall percentage change be claimed?
challenge.expected: September known TWD total is 100. October known TWD subtotal is 200 with meals unknown; the separate 10 USD cannot be added directly. Courses increase by 200, but percentage change is undefined with a zero baseline. The complete October total and overall percentage change are unconfirmed; a known subtotal is not a complete total.

checks: Independently checked 2100→2350, +250, and 11.9%.
>50 selects 1 category; >=50 selects 3; original data unchanged.
Refund results are 2250, +150, 7.1%; missing remains distinct from zero.

quiz.question: How many original categories meet 'at least 50'?
quiz.explanation: At least includes equality, so 150, 50, and 50 all qualify. Filtering does not change the original totals.

zh-Hant.title: 請 AI 做一個真正的小網頁
zh-Hant.goal: 實際請AI產生HTML，保存、重開並測試自己的第一版。
zh-Hant.quick: 展示你自己的AI需求與產生的HTML，勾兩項後取消一項，再重設；只有本站範本不算完成AI製作。
zh-Hant.skip: 已有自己的AI產生檔且能完成保存與測試，可直接加搜尋挑戰。
zh-Hant.source: 虛構清單：標題『出發前檢查』；三項任務依序為『下載車票』『確認集合地點』『帶水壺』。本題不用網路、不保存進度；重新開啟時回到0/3。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請依來源產生一個完整、可獨立開啟的HTML檔，包含CSS和JavaScript，不用外部套件、網路或追蹤。保留三項文字與順序；每項有可點文字的核取方塊；顯示已完成n/3；重設按鈕取消全部勾選並歸零。窄螢幕能操作，鍵盤能聚焦與勾選。頁面明寫『不保存進度，重新開啟歸零』，初始化清除勾選；不要使用localStorage。只回傳完整HTML，另用短句說明如何保存。
steps: 建立本機練習資料夾ai-practice；把來源與問題送給能產生程式碼的AI，保存自己的提問。
取得從<!doctype html>到</html>的完整程式碼。若有省略號或『其餘同上』，要求補齊可單獨執行的完整檔案。
用純文字編輯器貼上程式碼，不含Markdown的三個反引號。另存為checklist.html、UTF-8；Windows記事本選所有檔案，確認不是checklist.html.txt。
用瀏覽器開啟檔案，勾前兩項應2/3，取消第一項應1/3，按重設應0/3。核對三項原文字，縮窄視窗並用Tab與空白鍵操作。
關閉檔案分頁後重新開啟，應0/3。若不符，把操作、預期、實際回報AI修正，保存新版本並重測。
自己將『帶水壺』改成『帶筆記本』，請AI只改該項；另存checklist-v2.html，重新核對文字與2→1→0。
zh-Hant.expected: 交付物是自己向AI提出需求後得到的完整HTML、提問紀錄與測試紀錄。初版三項符合來源；操作2/3→1/3→0/3；重開0/3。第二版只有第三項改成帶筆記本，計數仍正確。畫面可不同，不要求程式碼與教材相同；本站固定產生器不替代此步。

independent.task: 新虛構清單：『讀書準備』，任務『選一篇文章』『記下三個問題』。自行寫需求請AI產生另一個不保存進度的HTML，保存study.html並測勾選、取消、重設及重開。
independent.expected: 初始0/2；兩項全勾2/2；取消一項1/2；重設0/2；重開0/2。需有自己的需求與實際產生檔，任務文字不得變成解說段落。

challenge.task: 加搜尋但不改變完成計數口徑。先貼上你已完成的完整HTML；尚未有檔案者先完成主練習。在同一AI對話確認目前完整版本，再貼下方新需求，不假設AI看得到本機檔案。
challenge.source: 虛構三項：下載車票、確認集合地點、帶筆記本。搜尋只影響顯示；計數仍統計全部三項；重設清除全部勾選及搜尋。
challenge.prompt: 在我的完整HTML加上文字搜尋，依來源規則；保留原功能與不保存進度。先列測試預期再提供完整檔案。
challenge.expected: 先勾下載車票與帶筆記本為2/3；搜尋『車票』只顯示一項，計數仍2/3；取消可見項後1/3；清除搜尋可看見帶筆記本仍勾選；重設後三項可見且0/3。

checks: 保留自己的AI提問與完整HTML檔。
保存副檔名正確，可關閉後重開。
初版及個人修改版都實測2→1→0，重開歸零。

quiz.question: 什麼才完成本課的AI製作部分？
choices: 自己提出需求，取得AI產生的HTML並保存測試
quiz.explanation: 本課要求實際產碼、保存及測試；範本可示範，但不能替代這些證據。

en.title: Ask AI to build a small webpage
en.goal: Actually request AI-generated HTML, save it, reopen it, and test your first version.
en.quick: Show your own AI request and generated HTML. Check two items, uncheck one, and reset. Using only this site's template does not complete AI creation.
en.skip: If you already have your own generated file and can save and test it, go to the search challenge.
en.source: Fictional checklist: title 'Before departure'; tasks in order: 'Download tickets', 'Confirm meeting location', 'Bring a water bottle'. No network or progress saving; reopening starts at 0/3.
en.prompt: Generate a complete standalone HTML file from the source, including CSS and JavaScript. No external libraries, network, or tracking. Preserve the three tasks and order. Each task needs a checkbox with a clickable label. Display n/3 completed. A reset button clears all checks and returns the count to zero. Support narrow screens, keyboard focus, and keyboard checking. Clearly state 'Progress is not saved; reopening resets it.' Clear checked states on initialization; do not use localStorage. Return complete HTML and a short saving instruction.
steps: Create a local ai-practice folder. Submit the source and prompt to a code-capable AI tool and save your request.
Obtain complete code from <!doctype html> through </html>. If it contains omissions or 'same as above,' ask for the entire standalone file.
Paste it into a plain-text editor without Markdown triple backticks. Save as checklist.html in UTF-8. In Windows Notepad select all files and check that it is not checklist.html.txt.
Open the file in a browser. Check the first two items: 2/3. Uncheck the first: 1/3. Reset: 0/3. Verify all original labels, narrow the window, and use Tab and Space to operate it.
Close the file tab and reopen it: expect 0/3. If it fails, report steps, expected result, and actual result to AI; save a corrected version and retest.
Make your own change from 'Bring a water bottle' to 'Bring a notebook.' Ask AI to change only that item. Save checklist-v2.html and verify the labels and 2→1→0 again.
en.expected: Deliver your own request, the complete AI-generated HTML, and a test record. Version one has the three source tasks; operations yield 2/3→1/3→0/3; reopening yields 0/3. Version two changes only the third task to Bring a notebook and retains correct counting. Appearance and code may differ from examples. This site's fixed generator does not replace this work.

independent.task: New fictional checklist: 'Reading preparation', with 'Choose an article' and 'Write three questions'. Write your own request for another HTML file without progress saving, save study.html, and test checking, unchecking, reset, and reopening.
independent.expected: Initial 0/2; both checked 2/2; uncheck one 1/2; reset 0/2; reopen 0/2. Provide your own request and actual generated file. Task labels must not become explanatory paragraphs.

challenge.task: Add search without changing the counting scope. First paste your completed full HTML. If you do not have a file, complete the guided task first. Confirm the current complete version in the same AI chat before submitting the new requirement; do not assume AI can see your local file.
challenge.source: Three fictional tasks: Download tickets, Confirm meeting location, Bring a notebook. Search changes visibility only; the count includes all three tasks. Reset clears every checkbox and the search.
challenge.prompt: Add text search to my complete HTML using these rules. Preserve existing features and no progress saving. List test expectations first, then provide the complete file.
challenge.expected: Check Download tickets and Bring a notebook: 2/3. Search 'tickets': only one item is visible, count remains 2/3. Uncheck it: 1/3. Clear search: Bring a notebook is still checked. Reset: all three visible and 0/3.

checks: Retained my own AI request and complete HTML file.
Correct extension; file can be closed and reopened.
Tested 2→1→0 on both initial and personally modified versions; reopening resets.

quiz.question: What completes this lesson's AI creation requirement?
choices: Write a request, obtain AI-generated HTML, save and test it
Only operate this site's fixed template
quiz.explanation: Actual generation, saving, and testing are required. A template can demonstrate behavior but cannot replace that evidence.

zh-Hant.title: 改壞了怎麼辦：測試、除錯、復原
zh-Hant.goal: 重現計數錯誤，做最小修正，測試並保留可復原版本。
zh-Hant.quick: 開故障清單只勾第一項：預期1，實際是多少？用可重現步驟報告，不只說『壞了』。
zh-Hant.skip: 能提供錯誤步驟、原因、最小修正、2→1→0回歸與復原證據，可直接做獨立題。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構故障練習檔：downloads/curriculum/broken-checklist-zh-Hant.html；對照可用檔：downloads/curriculum/correct-checklist-zh-Hant.html。
故障計數只看checkboxes.slice(1)，因此漏掉第一個核取方塊。三項依序為下載車票、確認集合地點、帶水壺。修正目標是統計全部項目，不改任務文字。
zh-Hant.prompt: 我會貼上故障HTML。請先說明為何只勾第一項顯示0而應為1、勾前兩項顯示1而應為2。只修正計數範圍中slice(1)漏第一項的問題，提供完整修正版與最小差異；保留文字、重設及不保存進度。請列回歸測試。
steps: 下載本課故障檔及可用對照檔到練習資料夾；保留可用對照檔為baseline.html，不直接覆寫。先開baseline確認前兩項→2、取消第一項→1、重設→0。
開故障檔，先重設，再只勾第一項：預期1/3、實際0/3；再勾第二項：預期2/3、實際1/3。記下檔名、順序、預期及實際。
以純文字編輯器開故障檔，把完整HTML及問題送給AI。核對修正只移除計數範圍的.slice(1)，不是把顯示值硬加1。
另存fixed.html並測前兩項2/3→取消第一項1/3→重設0/3；再單勾第一項1/3。核對原文字、窄視窗及鍵盤操作。
復原演練：把baseline.html複製為restore-check.html，開啟並重測2→1→0。保存故障報告、修正版、備份與測試結果。
zh-Hant.expected: 故障根因：slice(1)跳過索引0。修正：計數時使用完整checkboxes，移除.slice(1)。不是在結果加1，因為全未勾應0。修正版單勾第一項1/3、前兩項2/3、取消第一項1/3、重設0/3；復原副本也通過2→1→0。

independent.task: 下載獨立題虛構故障檔downloads/curriculum/reset-bug-zh-Hant.html，另存副本再測。兩項讀書任務為「選文章」「寫三個問題」，起始0/2，勾兩項2/2；按重設後兩個勾都清掉，數字卻仍2/2。此指定檔確實定義updateCount()，但reset只清勾而未呼叫它。以文字編輯器開啟此檔，把完整內容與你的重現報告交給AI，要求最小修正，另存後重測；可下載correct-reset-zh-Hant.html對照，不套用到不明結構的其他程式。
independent.expected: 重現：重開→勾兩項→重設；預期未勾且0/2，實際未勾但2/2。清勾後加updateCount()；測2→重設0→再勾第一項1。不能只隱藏錯誤數字。

challenge.task: 下載固定搜尋／重設故障檔search-reset-bug-zh-Hant.html，保留原檔並另存副本。先重現隱藏項未清除，再把完整程式碼交AI最小修正，最後回歸測試。
challenge.source: 虛構故障檔：downloads/curriculum/search-reset-bug-zh-Hant.html；對照檔：downloads/curriculum/correct-search-reset-zh-Hant.html。三項依序為下載車票、確認集合地點、帶水壺。計數應包含全部項目；搜尋只影響顯示；重設應清除所有勾選及搜尋。刻意錯誤：重設只清除目前可見項，隨後清搜尋，因此原先隱藏的勾選仍保留。
challenge.prompt: 我會貼上這份故障HTML。先說明並重現：勾第一與第三項為2/3；搜尋「車票」只見第一項但仍2/3；按重設預期全顯且0/3，實際全顯但1/3、第三項仍勾。請只修正reset，讓它遍歷所有核取方塊而非僅可見項，保留搜尋及計數範圍。回傳完整修正版與最小差異，列回歸步驟。
challenge.expected: 故障重現：勾1與3→2/3；搜車票→只1項可見、仍2/3；重設→全顯但1/3（第三仍勾）。修正後同樣操作，重設必須全顯且0/3，隱藏的第三項也已清除。再勾前兩項2/3→取消第一項1/3→重設0/3；搜尋仍只改顯示、不改計數範圍。修正只將reset清除範圍改為全部checkbox，不刪除第三項或硬把數字設0來掩蓋殘留勾選。保留原檔，需復原時重新開啟它。

checks: 保留已測過的可用備份。
錯誤報告可讓另一人依步驟重現。
最小修正與復原副本都實測2→1→0。

quiz.question: 為什麼不能把故障計數一律加1？
choices: 全未勾會變1，掩蓋錯誤且製造新錯誤
quiz.explanation: 應修正被漏掉的計數範圍，不能用常數補償所有狀態。

en.title: Test, debug, and restore a tool
en.goal: Reproduce a counting bug, apply a minimal fix, test, and retain a restorable version.
en.quick: In the broken checklist, check only the first item. Expected 1; what actually appears? Report reproducible steps, not just 'broken.'
en.skip: Go to independent practice if you can show reproduction, cause, minimal fix, 2→1→0 regression, and restoration evidence.
en.source:
Fictional broken exercise file: downloads/curriculum/broken-checklist-en.html; working reference: downloads/curriculum/correct-checklist-en.html.
The faulty count uses checkboxes.slice(1), omitting the first checkbox. Tasks in order: Download tickets, Confirm meeting location, Bring a water bottle. Count every item without changing task labels.
en.prompt: I will paste the broken HTML. First explain why checking only the first item shows 0 instead of 1, and checking the first two shows 1 instead of 2. Fix only the counting scope that omits the first item through slice(1). Provide complete corrected HTML and the minimal difference. Preserve labels, reset, and no progress saving. List regression tests.
steps: Download the broken and working reference files into your practice folder. Preserve the working file as baseline.html. Open it first and verify first two checked→2, first unchecked→1, reset→0.
Open the broken file and reset. Check only the first item: expected 1/3, actual 0/3. Check the second too: expected 2/3, actual 1/3. Record filename, sequence, expected, and actual results.
Open the broken file in a text editor and send its complete HTML and the prompt to AI. Verify that the fix removes .slice(1) from the counting scope rather than adding 1 to the display.
Save as fixed.html. Test first two checked 2/3→uncheck first 1/3→reset 0/3, then first alone 1/3. Verify original labels, narrow-window use, and keyboard operation.
Rehearse restoration: copy baseline.html to restore-check.html, open it, and retest 2→1→0. Save the bug report, fixed version, backup, and test results.
en.expected: Cause: slice(1) skips index 0. Fix: count the full checkboxes collection by removing .slice(1). Do not add 1, because no checks must yield 0. Corrected results: first alone 1/3; first two 2/3; uncheck first 1/3; reset 0/3. The restored copy also passes 2→1→0.

independent.task: Download the fictional independent-task bug file downloads/curriculum/reset-bug-en.html and save a copy before testing. Its two reading tasks are Choose an article and Write three questions. It starts at 0/2; checking both gives 2/2. Reset clears the checks but still displays 2/2. This specific file defines updateCount(), but reset clears checks without calling it. Open this file in a text editor and send its complete contents with your reproduction report to AI. Request a minimal fix, save separately, and retest. Download correct-reset-en.html for comparison; do not apply the change to unrelated code with an unknown structure.
independent.expected: Reproduce: reopen→check both→reset. Expected unchecked and 0/2; actual unchecked and 2/2. Call updateCount() after clearing checks. Test 2→reset 0→check first 1. Do not merely hide the incorrect number.

challenge.task: Download the fixed search/reset bug exercise search-reset-bug-en.html, preserve the original, and save a working copy. Reproduce the uncleared hidden item, send the full code to AI for a minimal fix, and run regression tests.
challenge.source: Fictional bug file: downloads/curriculum/search-reset-bug-en.html; reference fix: downloads/curriculum/correct-search-reset-en.html. Tasks in order: Download tickets, Confirm meeting location, Bring a water bottle. The count includes all items; search changes visibility only; reset must clear every checkbox and search. Intentional bug: reset clears only currently visible items before clearing search, leaving hidden checked items checked.
challenge.prompt: I will paste this broken HTML. Explain and reproduce: check the first and third items for 2/3; search tickets so only the first is visible, still 2/3; reset should show all items at 0/3, but actually shows all at 1/3 with the third still checked. Fix only reset so it traverses all checkboxes rather than just visible ones. Preserve search and counting scope. Return the complete fixed file, minimal difference, and regression steps.
challenge.expected: Reproduction: check items 1 and 3→2/3; search tickets→one visible, still 2/3; reset→all visible but 1/3, with the third still checked. After the fix, the same sequence must reset to all visible and 0/3, clearing the hidden third item too. Then check the first two 2/3→uncheck first 1/3→reset 0/3. Search still changes only visibility, not counting scope. Change the reset clearing scope to all checkboxes; do not delete the third item or force the display to zero while leaving it checked. Preserve the original and reopen it if restoration is needed.

checks: Retained a tested working backup.
Another person can reproduce the bug from my report.
Tested 2→1→0 on the minimal fix and restored copy.

quiz.question: Why not add 1 to every faulty count?
choices: No checked items would show 1, masking the bug and creating another
quiz.explanation: Fix the omitted counting scope instead of applying a constant to every state.

zh-Hant.title: 規則與自動化：讓流程重複做
zh-Hant.goal: 以模擬感測事件驗證邊界、缺值與去重，分清規則和外部動作。
zh-Hant.quick: 規則是溫度>=28°C：27、28、29、缺值各會發生什麼？同一事件重送可不可以再發通知？
zh-Hant.skip: 能交出正常、邊界、缺值、重複四種結果，並指出外部控制尚未執行，可直接做重試挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構Home感測事件模擬，不連接設備。原應用方向是真實感測資料驅動空調規則；本課只重現邏輯。
規格：收到事件→檢查event_id是否已處理→驗證溫度為數字→若>=28°C，記一筆『空調啟動請求（模擬）』及通知；低於28不請求；缺值記未知、不控制。每個新事件記處理結果，同ID不再產生請求或通知。
依序事件：E01,27；E02,28；E03,29；E04,缺值；E02,28（重送）。
zh-Hant.prompt: 只模擬上述規則，依序列event_id、溫度、判定、模擬請求數、通知數、原因。記住已處理ID。不要真的連接空調或設定排程。說明哪些是確定性規則、AI可協助什麼、哪些外部動作未執行。
steps: 先手寫四個溫度的預測，圈出28是邊界而不是大於28。
把規格與事件交給AI逐筆模擬；檢查重送E02有沒有再次觸發。
將條件暫改成>28，預測只有E02的邊界判定會改；重跑新的一批模擬後對照，再還原>=28。每批從空的已處理ID集合開始。
畫出或寫出流程：事件→去重→驗值→比較→模擬請求／未知→記錄。區分AI寫規格、程式判條件與真正執行設備控制。
保存五列結果及版本。這份模擬不是已建立排程或已控制設備的證據。
zh-Hant.expected: E01 27：不啟動，0請求0通知。E02 28：模擬啟動，1請求1通知。E03 29：模擬啟動，1請求1通知。E04缺值：未知，0請求0通知。重送E02：略過，0新增請求0新增通知。合計2請求2通知。>28的新批次僅E03啟動，合計1；還原>=28回到2。比較及去重是規則；AI可協助撰寫與解釋，未真正控制設備。

independent.task: 新虛構事件與規則：濕度>=70%發一筆除濕提醒（只模擬）；依ID去重，缺值記未知。依序H01,69；H02,70；H03,71；H04,缺值；H02,70重送。自行列逐筆結果。
independent.expected: H01不提醒；H02提醒1；H03提醒1；H04未知不提醒；重送H02略過。合計2筆提醒。70必須符合；缺值不是0%。

challenge.task: 寫清楚失敗重試與冷卻的狀態。
challenge.source: 虛構模擬，時間Asia/Taipei。規格：>=28產生請求；同ID最多嘗試2次（含首次）；僅成功後記已處理並通知；仍失敗交人工；通知成功後5分鐘內的其他事件可以有請求但不再通知。R1 10:00溫度28，首次失敗，10:01重試成功；R1 10:02重送；R2 10:03溫度29，成功；R3 10:07溫度28，兩次都失敗。
challenge.prompt: 只做狀態模擬，依序列嘗試次數、成功／失敗、去重與通知。不要真的重試任何外部服務。
challenge.expected: R1共2次嘗試，10:01成功並通知1；10:02重送略過。R2嘗試1次成功，但距上次通知2分鐘，冷卻中不通知。R3嘗試2次皆失敗，停止並交人工，未記成功、無成功通知。總嘗試5次、成功事件2個、通知1筆；不能無限重試。

checks: 27／28／29／缺值四種結果正確。
同E02重送沒有新增動作。
模擬、確定性規則、AI協助及實際設備控制分清楚。

quiz.question: 規格>=28°C，溫度缺值時應如何？
choices: 標示未知，不發控制請求
quiz.explanation: 缺值無法比較，不能偷偷轉成0或門檻值。

en.title: Rules and automation: repeat a workflow
en.goal: Test boundaries, missing values, and deduplication with simulated sensor events; separate rules from external actions.
en.quick: For temperature >=28°C, what happens at 27, 28, 29, and missing? May the same event send a second notification?
en.skip: Go to the retry challenge if you can show normal, boundary, missing, and duplicate cases and identify that external control has not occurred.
en.source:
Fictional Home sensor-event simulation; no device connection. The application direction uses real sensor data to drive air-conditioning rules; this lesson reconstructs only the logic.
Rule: receive event→check whether event_id was processed→validate numeric temperature→if >=28°C, record one 'air-conditioning activation request (simulated)' and one notification; below 28 makes no request; missing means unknown, no control. Record each new event's result; the same ID creates no further request or notification.
Events in order: E01,27; E02,28; E03,29; E04,missing; E02,28 (redelivery).
en.prompt: Simulate only these rules. In order, show event_id, temperature, decision, simulated request count, notification count, and reason. Track processed IDs. Do not connect an air conditioner or set a schedule. Identify deterministic rules, where AI can help, and external actions not performed.
steps: Write predictions for the four temperatures, noting that 28 is included in >=28.
Submit rules and events to AI for sequential simulation. Check whether redelivered E02 incorrectly triggers again.
Temporarily change the condition to >28. Predict that only E02's boundary decision changes. Run a fresh batch, compare, then restore >=28. Start each batch with an empty processed-ID set.
Draw or write the flow: event→deduplicate→validate→compare→simulated request or unknown→record. Distinguish AI writing specifications, code evaluating conditions, and actual device control.
Save the five result rows and rule version. This simulation does not prove that a schedule exists or a device was controlled.
en.expected: E01 27: no activation, 0 requests/0 notifications. E02 28: simulated activation, 1/1. E03 29: simulated activation, 1/1. E04 missing: unknown, 0/0. Redelivered E02: skipped, 0 new requests/0 new notifications. Total 2 requests and 2 notifications. A fresh >28 batch activates only E03, total 1; restoring >=28 gives 2. Comparison and deduplication are rules; AI can help write and explain them. No actual device was controlled.

independent.task: New fictional rule and events: humidity >=70% produces one dehumidification reminder, simulation only; deduplicate by ID and mark missing as unknown. In order: H01,69; H02,70; H03,71; H04,missing; H02,70 redelivery. List each result independently.
independent.expected: H01 no reminder; H02 one; H03 one; H04 unknown, none; duplicate H02 skipped. Total 2 reminders. 70 qualifies; missing is not 0%.

challenge.task: Specify failure retries and cooldown state explicitly.
challenge.source: Fictional simulation, Asia/Taipei. Rules: >=28 creates a request; at most 2 attempts per ID including the first; only success marks the event processed and allows notification; persistent failure goes to a person. Other events within 5 minutes after a successful notification may create requests but no notification. R1 at 10:00, 28°C: first attempt fails, retry succeeds 10:01. R1 redelivered 10:02. R2 at 10:03, 29°C: succeeds. R3 at 10:07, 28°C: both attempts fail.
challenge.prompt: Simulate state only. List attempts, success/failure, deduplication, and notifications in order. Do not retry any external service.
challenge.expected: R1: 2 attempts, succeeds and notifies once at 10:01; redelivery 10:02 skipped. R2: 1 successful attempt, no notification because only 2 minutes have passed. R3: 2 failed attempts, then stop and refer to a person; no success state or success notification. Total 5 attempts, 2 successful events, 1 notification. No unlimited retries.

checks: Correct results for 27, 28, 29, and missing.
Redelivery of E02 creates no additional action.
Clearly separated simulation, deterministic rules, AI help, and actual device control.

quiz.question: Under >=28°C, what should happen when temperature is missing?
choices: Mark unknown and make no control request
quiz.explanation: Missing data cannot be compared and must not silently become zero or the threshold.

zh-Hant.title: 同一份內容，換人與換語言也看得懂
zh-Hant.goal: 改寫語氣與長度，同時維持日期、時區、金額、動作與未知。
zh-Hant.quick: 將L1寫成中文短版與英文版，再逐項核對關鍵事實；不以流暢當作正確。
zh-Hant.skip: 能交出兩版與事實對照，保留未知和原名，可直接做口語稿挑戰。
zh-Hant.source: 虛構通知L1：『雲岸共學』活動於2026/11/21 09:00（Asia/Taipei）在雲樓A室舉行；費用每人300 TWD；請於2026/11/18 18:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆參加；午餐另計，價格未定。活動與場地無核准英文名稱。
zh-Hant.prompt: 依L1寫給參加者的中文短版與英文版，清楚分開活動時間與回覆期限。保留金額、每人單位、時區、午餐未知；活動與場地保留原中文名稱，不自行宣稱官方譯名。附事實對照表。
steps: 先從來源列六個不能改的欄位：活動日期時間、場地、每人費用、回覆期限、午餐限制、名稱狀態。
把來源與問題交給AI產生兩版；回來源逐欄核對，不只檢查語句通順。
追問『中文改得更親切、英文更簡短，但不得刪掉期限、時區與午餐未知』，比對修改前後。
保存來源、兩版與核對表；不確定的專有名詞留原文與待確認。
zh-Hant.expected: 中文：『雲岸共學』11/21 09:00於雲樓A室舉行，每人300 TWD；請於11/18 18:00前回覆。日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei；午餐另計、價格待確認。英文：Join 雲岸共學 at 雲樓A室 on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), 300 TWD per person. Reply by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Lunch costs extra; the price is unconfirmed. 核對：兩版六欄一致，沒有新造官方名稱。

independent.task: 新虛構L2：2026/12/03 15:00（Asia/Taipei）『紙上散步』於B室；免費；12/01 12:00（Asia/Taipei）前登記；是否提供材料未知。無官方英文活動名。自行寫中英兩版及核對表。
independent.expected: 中文保留12/03 15:00、B室、免費、12/01 12:00登記期限、材料未知。英文可寫：紙上散步 is at Room B on 2026/12/03 at 15:00 (Asia/Taipei), free of charge. Register by 2026/12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials provision is unconfirmed. 不把免費延伸成含材料。

challenge.task: 把新通知改成兩句口語稿，仍保留限制。
challenge.source: 虛構L3：2026/12/10 19:00（Asia/Taipei）線上交流；12/08 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前報名；費用200 TWD／人；參加連結尚未提供。
challenge.prompt: 各寫中文與英文兩句口語稿。第一句活動與費用，第二句期限與未知連結，不能臆造URL。
challenge.expected: 中：12月10日19:00有線上交流，每人200 TWD。請於12月8日17:00前報名，參加連結待提供；以上日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei。英：The online exchange is on 2026/12/10 at 19:00 (Asia/Taipei), at 200 TWD per person. Register by 2026/12/08 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); the access link has not been provided. 可調整句型，但不能漏時區或填入虛構連結。

checks: 兩個語言版本皆完成。
日期、時間、單位、限制與未知逐欄相同。
專有名詞未擅自變成官方譯名。

quiz.question: L1英文版可以說午餐已包含嗎？
choices: 不行；來源說另計且價格未定
quiz.explanation: 改寫可以縮短措辭，不能更改包含範圍。

en.title: Adapt content for a different audience or language
en.goal: Change tone and length while preserving dates, time zone, amounts, actions, and unknowns.
en.quick: Turn L1 into a short Chinese notice and an English version, then verify each key fact. Fluency is not proof of accuracy.
en.skip: Go to the spoken-script challenge if both versions and your fact comparison preserve unknowns and original names.
en.source: Fictional notice L1: 雲岸共學 takes place on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), at 雲樓A室; 300 TWD per person. Reply whether attending by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Lunch costs extra; its price is undecided. Neither activity nor venue has an approved English name.
en.prompt: Using L1, write a short Chinese notice and an English version for attendees. Distinguish activity time and reply deadline. Preserve price, per-person unit, time zone, and unknown lunch cost. Keep activity and venue names in Chinese without claiming an official translation. Include a fact comparison.
steps: Extract six fields that cannot change: activity date/time, venue, per-person fee, reply deadline, lunch limitation, and name status.
Submit source and prompt for both versions. Verify each field against the source rather than checking fluency alone.
Follow up: 'Make Chinese friendlier and English shorter without removing the deadline, time zone, or unknown lunch cost.' Compare before and after.
Save the source, both versions, and comparison. Keep uncertain proper names in the original language and mark them for confirmation.
en.expected: Chinese: 『雲岸共學』11/21 09:00於雲樓A室舉行，每人300 TWD；請於11/18 18:00前回覆。日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei；午餐另計、價格待確認。 English: Join 雲岸共學 at 雲樓A室 on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), 300 TWD per person. Reply by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Lunch costs extra; the price is unconfirmed. All six fields agree, with no invented official names.

independent.task: New fictional L2: 紙上散步 at Room B on 2026/12/03 15:00 (Asia/Taipei); free; register by 12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei); materials provision unknown. No official English activity name. Write both language versions and a fact comparison independently.
independent.expected: Chinese preserves 12/03 15:00, B室, free admission, 12/01 12:00 registration deadline, and unknown materials. English example: 紙上散步 is at Room B on 2026/12/03 at 15:00 (Asia/Taipei), free of charge. Register by 2026/12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials provision is unconfirmed. Free admission does not imply included materials.

challenge.task: Make a two-sentence spoken script while retaining limitations.
challenge.source: Fictional L3: online exchange 2026/12/10 19:00 (Asia/Taipei); register by 12/08 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); 200 TWD per person; access link not yet provided.
challenge.prompt: Write two sentences each in Chinese and English: activity and price first, then deadline and missing link. Do not invent a URL.
challenge.expected: Chinese: 12月10日19:00有線上交流，每人200 TWD。請於12月8日17:00前報名，參加連結待提供；以上日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei。 English: The online exchange is on 2026/12/10 at 19:00 (Asia/Taipei), at 200 TWD per person. Register by 2026/12/08 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); the access link has not been provided. Wording can vary; time zone and missing-link status cannot be dropped.

checks: Completed both language versions.
Dates, times, units, limitations, and unknowns match field by field.
Did not turn invented proper-name translations into official names.

quiz.question: May L1's English version say lunch is included?
choices: No; the source says extra cost with price undecided
Yes, because there is an admission fee
quiz.explanation: Rewriting may shorten wording but cannot change what is included.

zh-Hant.title: 自選專題與交接：把自己的需求做成作品
zh-Hant.goal: 從四方向選一個小作品，加入自己的修改，讓同伴依說明操作及核對。
zh-Hant.quick: 選一個方向，用一句話寫使用者要做什麼、輸入是什麼、怎樣知道成功。已有作品者用新需求接受驗證。
zh-Hant.skip: 能提供來源、自己的修改、測試與同伴試走紀錄，可直接做來源變更挑戰；公開部署不是必需。
zh-Hant.source:
四組皆為公開虛構重現，選一組即可。
Travel：T1主辦核准2026/11/21 09:00雲岸車站集合；11/19 19:00（Asia/Taipei）前下載車票；入住未定。目標：來源可追溯的行程／待辦。
N1：自編練習，非正式試題。Q1『確認しないことには、返事ができない。』規則：ないことには表『如果不先…就不能…』。Q2『忙しいとはいえ、確認は必要だ。』規則：とはいえ表『雖說…但是…』。目標：兩題可核對的學習卡，不宣稱考試成效。
Home：模擬真感測空調規則，>=28°C產生啟動請求；E1=27、E2=28、E3=缺值、E2重送；依ID去重。目標：結果表或模擬器，不接設備。
TickForge：虛構成交量，非帳戶績效。K1｜D1｜成交量100；K1｜D2｜成交量130；K2｜D1｜成交量0；K2｜D2｜成交量20。目標：比較成交量變動，不提供交易建議或連接交易。
zh-Hant.prompt: 我選【填入Travel、N1、Home或TickForge一個】。只依對應來源，先列最小作品、輸入、可核對結果與三個驗收步驟，再製作第一版。缺資料請保留未知，不引用私人資料。若要HTML，請提供完整可保存檔案；如果先做文字／表格，清楚標示尚未做網頁。不要部署或連接外部系統。
steps: 選一方向並保留對應起步資料。網頁作品先具備M08/M09能力，分析型可用M07，規則型可用M10；不要求上完全部課。
自行寫一句最小需求後送出問題。Travel做三欄清單；N1做句子／意思／自測卡；Home做逐事件結果；TickForge做差額與百分比表。
用下方參考結果驗收第一版。若是網頁，要實際保存、開啟並操作；只有文字就誠實標示文字原型。
加入一項自己的需求並保存前後版：例如Travel加來源欄、N1加顯示答案、Home加重複提示、TickForge加零基期註記。先寫預期再測。
寫交接說明：如何開啟、輸入、一次操作、預期結果、資料限制、如何復原。請未參與製作的同伴照做，記錄實際結果；無同伴則標示待試走。
保存需求、來源、成品、修改、測試、交接與剩餘問題。這是作品證據，不以自評勾選代表已驗證。
zh-Hant.expected: Travel：下載期限11/19 19:00、集合11/21 09:00雲岸車站、入住未知，均2026年／Asia/Taipei，附T1；不得猜入住。N1：Q1『如果不先確認，就無法回覆』；Q2『雖然忙，仍有必要確認』；句型與來源規則一致，答案顯示前可自答。Home：E1不請求、E2一筆模擬請求、E3未知、重送E2略過，共1筆；明示未控制真設備。TickForge：K1增加30，30÷100=30.0%；K2增加20，基期0，百分比不適用；不能稱無限成長或獲利。每條路線另須有自己的修改、測試與交接紀錄；沒有完成的部分標待補。

independent.task: 選一組全新虛構資料，獨立做第二版。Travel：T2，2026/12/05 10:00雲樓集合，12/03 16:00前報名，交通方式未知，Asia/Taipei。N1：Q3『準備しないことには、始められない。』沿用『不先…就不能…』；Q4『短いとはいえ、内容は豊富だ。』沿用『雖說…但是…』。Home：F1=28、F2=29、F3缺值、F1重送，>=28及依ID去重。TickForge：K3 D1量200／D2量150，K4 D1量0／D2量0。僅使用所選資料，保存一項測試。
independent.expected: Travel：12/03 16:00報名、12/05 10:00雲樓集合、交通未知。N1：Q3不先準備就無法開始；Q4雖然短但內容豐富。Home：F1、F2各1筆模擬請求，缺值未知，重送略過，共2。TickForge：K3差-50、-25.0%；K4差0、百分比仍不適用（0÷0），不是0%。四選一核對即可，不混用第一版資料。

challenge.task: 對選定作品加入更新或反例，保留可復原版本。
challenge.source: 全虛構、四選一。Travel：T3主辦核准取代T1的下載期限，改2026/11/19 18:00，其餘不變。N1：Q5『忙しいとはいえ、確認は不要だ。』其中不要=不需要，不能套Q2的『仍有必要』。Home：新E4溫度文字『sensor error』，規格只接受數字。TickForge：新增K1 D2量130的相同列，完整鍵為代號+日期，重複列不重複加總。
challenge.prompt: 先保存原版，依我選的來源更新或加入反例。列出應改、不應改、預期結果與復原方法，再產生新版本；不要把缺值或重複資料當正常新值。

en.title: Choose, verify, and share a useful project
en.goal: Choose one small project, make a personal change, and let a partner operate and verify it from your instructions.
en.quick: Choose a direction and write one sentence stating the user's task, input, and observable success. Existing projects should face a new requirement.
en.skip: Go to the source-change challenge if you have sources, a personal change, tests, and a partner walkthrough record. Public deployment is optional.
en.source:
All four are public fictional reconstructions; choose one.
Travel: T1 organizer approval: meet 2026/11/21 09:00 at Cloudbank Station; download tickets by 11/19 19:00 (Asia/Taipei); check-in undecided. Goal: source-traceable itinerary/actions.
N1: original practice, not official exam questions. Q1 確認しないことには、返事ができない。 Rule: ないことには means 'unless you first…you cannot…'. Q2 忙しいとはいえ、確認は必要だ。 Rule: とはいえ means 'although…nevertheless…'. Goal: two verifiable study cards, without exam-outcome claims.
Home: simulation of sensor-driven air-conditioning rules: >=28°C generates an activation request; E1=27, E2=28, E3=missing, E2 redelivery; deduplicate by ID. Goal: results table or simulator, no device connection.
TickForge: fictional trading volume, not account performance. K1 | D1 | volume100; K1 | D2 | volume130; K2 | D1 | volume0; K2 | D2 | volume20. Goal: compare volume changes; no trading advice or trading connection.
en.prompt: I choose [enter one: Travel, N1, Home, or TickForge]. Using only that source, define the smallest artifact, inputs, verifiable result, and three acceptance steps, then build version one. Preserve unknowns and use no private data. If making HTML, provide a complete saveable file. If starting with text or a table, clearly label it as not yet a webpage. Do not deploy or connect external systems.
steps: Choose one direction and retain its starter data. Web projects require M08/M09 skills, analysis can use M07, and rules can use M10. Completing every lesson is unnecessary.

Write your own one-sentence requirement and submit the prompt. Travel: three-field checklist; N1: sentence/meaning/self-test cards; Home: event-by-event results; TickForge: differences and percentages table.
Verify version one against the reference below. A webpage must actually be saved, opened, and operated. A text-only artifact should honestly be labeled a text prototype.
Add one personal requirement and save before/after versions: e.g., a Travel source column, N1 answer reveal, Home duplicate notice, or TickForge zero-baseline note. Write expectations before testing.

Write handoff instructions: how to open, input, perform one action, verify the result, understand data limits, and restore. Ask someone uninvolved in building to follow them and record actual results. Without a partner, mark the walkthrough pending.
Save requirements, source, artifact, change, tests, handoff, and unresolved issues. These are project evidence; self-reported checkmarks do not verify the work.
en.expected: Travel: download deadline 11/19 19:00; meet 11/21 09:00 at Cloudbank Station; check-in unknown; all 2026/Asia/Taipei, source T1. Do not guess check-in. N1: Q1 'Unless I check first, I cannot reply'; Q2 'Although busy, checking is still necessary'; meanings match supplied rules and allow an answer before reveal. Home: E1 no request, E2 one simulated request, E3 unknown, duplicate E2 skipped; total 1, explicitly no real device control. TickForge: K1 +30, 30÷100=30.0%; K2 +20 with percentage undefined due to zero baseline; neither infinite growth nor profit. Each route also needs a personal change, tests, and handoff record; unfinished parts remain pending.

Home: F1 and F2 each generate one simulated request; missing unknown, duplicate skipped; total 2. TickForge: K3 -50, -25.0%; K4 difference0, percentage still undefined (0÷0), not 0%. Verify only your chosen route without mixing version-one data.

challenge.task: Add an update or counterexample to your chosen artifact, retaining a restorable version.
challenge.source: All fictional; choose one. Travel: organizer-approved T3 replaces T1's download deadline with 2026/11/19 18:00; all else unchanged. N1: Q5 忙しいとはいえ、確認は不要だ。 Here 不要 means unnecessary; do not reuse Q2's 'still necessary'. Home: new E4 temperature is text 'sensor error'; only numeric values are accepted. TickForge: a duplicate K1 D2 volume130 row is added; full key is code+date; do not sum duplicate rows twice.
challenge.prompt: Save the original first. Apply my chosen update or counterexample. List what should change, what should not, expected results, and restoration steps, then produce a new version. Do not treat missing or duplicate data as a normal new value.
challenge.expected: Travel: only download changes to 18:00; meeting remains09:00 and check-in unknown. N1 Q5: 'Although busy, checking is unnecessary'; reflect the difference between 不要 and 必要 instead of copying Q2. Home E4 invalid/unknown, 0 requests, not converted to0°C. TickForge: retain the identical key/value row once; K1 remains100→130,+30,30.0%. Conflicting values under one key require confirmation. Restore by reopening the saved prior version and rerunning its original cases.

checks: A small artifact with traceable fictional sources.
My personal change has before/after versions and actual tests.
Handoff instructions are executable; pending partner walkthroughs are explicitly marked.
Text prototypes, actual HTML, simulation, and external operations are distinct; unperformed work is not claimed complete.
